notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hello! I first want to say; a huge thanks to anyone who has supported the game!

Echoria: Ancient Echoes was very a transformative experience for me to develop.
Never before have I put as much time and effort into anything in my life!
I believe that this was a necessary step towards my growth, both personally and professionally.

Unfortunately, it looks like the updates and sequels that I'd planned are on the back-burner 
(perhaps indefinitely) due to a lack of interest. I do however want as many people as possible to 
enjoy the game, so it's currently on sale for 75% off!

I'd also like to announce that my main development platform has shifted from RPG Maker, to Unity!
With everything that I've learned along the way, I've been working diligently on a new title 
(unannounced tactical rogue-like) and am extremely excited to begin sharing the progress that I've made!

Follow me [url=https://twitter.com/adam_waind]@adam_waind on twitter[/url] for updates, and thanks for reading!

-Adam Waind

notes.title: Game Update! Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Big thanks to everyone who pointed these bugs out!

Version 1.0.1 Bug Fixes:

-Fixed a bug where you sometimes wouldn't get item rewards shown on the battle result page
-Ranheim's name now no longer reverts back to Ranheim if you chose another name for him
-The Mimic chest in Almas Sewers now actually contains a mimic (game no longer crashes)
-Several rare items that were supposed to drop now actually drop from mimics
-Added save point in Almas Sewers
-Added a hint and dialogue to the "thick roots" puzzle in Gwirion Forest
-Added a hint and dialogue to the Ardua Caverns jumping area
-Added a healing spot in the Ardua Caverns exit
-Added additional cutscene material when meeting Rach

Next in the update queue is:
-Steam Achievements
-Steam Controller Support
-Steam Link Support

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: ECHORIA: Ancient Echoes - Available Now!
notes.notes:
ECHORIA: Ancient Echoes is available now!

I will continue to update the game if any further changes/fixes are needed. Future updates will include steam achievements, as well as steam controller and steam link support. 

Thank you to all who showed initial interest, played the demo and gave valuable feedback! It means a lot to me!
